meta.task: Y3 - walking-route check feeding the 30-minute rule
meta.rule: a hotel is usable for a day only if the walk to the room hosting that day's events fits inside 30 minutes
meta.method: OpenStreetMap foot-route length between each property's building point and each event room's building point, converted to minutes at a stated pace
meta.why_not_the_server_durations: the demo router's foot durations came back at 4-8 m/s, which is not walking speed, so only its route lengths were used
meta.official_note: no Strip property publishes a door-to-door walking time to another property's poker room, so nothing here is an official figure: it is a measurement from public mapping data, dated, and reproducible from the two captures
meta.credits: Map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL, http://osm.org/copyright

pairs.measured_between: The Venetian Las Vegas point -> The Palazzo point
pairs.status: same complex, no public-way route to measure
pairs.basis: OpenStreetMap foot-route length 410.0 m between the two property points, recorded for completeness only
caveats: one complex: the route is inside the property, so it is not a street walk and the distance is building-point to building-point

pairs.measured_between: The Venetian Las Vegas point -> Wynn Las Vegas point
pairs.status: route length measured from the property points in the geocode capture (building centroids, not doors); minutes are an estimate at a stated pace
pairs.basis: OpenStreetMap foot-route length 1163.3 m between the two property points, divided by 80 m/min (4.8 km/h) and rounded up
